procedure_text: 与实施例1所述步骤相同，得到含量为98.2％的2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸钠盐；
procedure_summary: The methyl ester of the chloro bromomethyl methanesulfonyl benzoic acid is cleaved to the sodium benzoate salt by the procedure of the earlier worked example, the benzylic bromide surviving. Nothing of the procedure is printed here; only the product and its stated content are given.
notes: Cross-reference only. The paragraph prints no procedure for step (1): it states that the procedure is the same as the one described in Example 1 and gives the product content as 98.2 percent. This patent marks its experimental steps (1) and (2) and does not use the marker form the pass prompt describes. reaction_class is hydrolysis because the transformation is cleavage of the methyl ester to the alkali metal benzoate with the benzylic bromide left intact; ester_formation would be the reverse and salt_formation alone would record only the counter ion. Confidence is medium because the classification rests on the referenced procedure and not on anything written here. No base, solvent, temperature, time or charge is given, so every condition field is null; conditions_inherited is true because the text says the procedure is the same as the referenced example. Sections are annotated in parallel, so the Example 1 records were not available to this call and the inherited conditions could not be checked against them: conditions_unresolved and cross_reference_unresolved are both raised rather than letting an unverified reference pass as if it had been checked. precursor_step is null because no earlier step of this section supplies material here; the pointer to Example 1 is a procedure reference, not a material one, and that is what linkage:cross_section_linked records. The methyl ester is emitted as this step's reactant although this paragraph does not name it: it is named in the closing sentence of step (2) as the basis of the two step yield, and A1 records it for this section as the material the referenced procedure consumes. Without it the record would have no reactant at all, which would be a recall miss rather than a faithful gap. No scheme is drawn for step (1) here, which is why this example carries one drawing where Examples 1 to 12 carry two. The 98.2 percent is a content and not a yield, so it is recorded as product purity with no method stated and product_yield_pct is left null.

steps: strip off the excess alcohol under reduced pressure with a high vacuum oil pump
seal the solid and keep it for later use
workup.concentration_method: stripping under reduced pressure with a high vacuum oil pump

compounds.addition_profile: charged first into the reaction kettle, then stirring started
added at room temperature into the stirred alcohol, then stirred until dissolution was complete

procedure_text: 向反应釜中加入50mL  2-四氢呋喃甲醇，开动搅拌，室温下投入5.2g氢化钠(60％，0.13mol)，搅拌至溶解完全，经高真空油泵负压脱溶后得到2-四氢呋喃甲醇醇钠固体，密封备用。
procedure_summary: Sodium hydride is added to tetrahydrofurfuryl alcohol in a stirred reaction kettle at room temperature and stirring is continued until dissolution is complete, converting the alcohol into its sodium alkoxide. The excess alcohol is stripped off under reduced pressure with a high vacuum oil pump and the solid alkoxide is sealed and kept for later use.
notes: The patent prints this alkoxide preparation inside its step (2), but it is a transformation in its own right, with its own charge and its own isolated and sealed product, so it gets its own record. The label Step 2a says where the document puts it; the etherification that follows is labelled Step 2b, so that the document's own marker (2) stays visible on both records that it covers and neither of them claims the marker alone. A0 estimated three steps for this section and this annotation emits three, so the counts agree: the cross-referenced step (1), this alkoxide preparation, and the etherification. Tetrahydrofurfuryl alcohol is both the medium and the reagent consumed, since the hydride is added to it and the excess is then stripped off, so it is carried as a reactant in agreement with A1, and solvent_class carries both neat, no separate solvent being added, and protic, the medium being an alcohol. reaction_class salt_formation is the closest of the permitted values: the alcohol is deprotonated and what is isolated is its sodium salt. Confidence is medium because no permitted class names alkoxide formation directly and hydrogen is evolved, so other was the alternative. mechanism_type ionic records the transfer of the hydroxyl proton to hydride; the text states no mechanism. No inert atmosphere, no reaction time and no stirrer type are given, so those fields stay null even though a sodium hydride dispersion is normally handled under inert gas: nothing is inferred here, and the sealing of the isolated solid is recorded as a workup step rather than read as an atmosphere. The vacuum stripping is a workup operation, so it sets the workup concentration method and not a reaction pressure. The Chinese name the patent prints for the alcohol is not a well formed name, as A1 records; it is kept as printed and not corrected. The mass, strength and mole figures printed for the sodium hydride charge close, so no arithmetic flag is raised; the working is in the provenance sidecar. The dropwise wording that the shared conventions warn about for hydrides is not used here: this hydride is charged as a solid.

conditions.ph_target_stage: workup acidification of the aqueous kettle residue with concentrated hydrochloric acid to pH 3

steps: strip off the solvent under reduced pressure
add water to the kettle residue and stir to dissolve
add concentrated hydrochloric acid dropwise to acidify the system to pH 3
workup.filtration: the acidified solid is collected by filtration and the cake rinsed with water

compounds.addition_profile: the tetrahydrofuran is added to the solid alkoxide and stirred to dissolve it
added to the solid alkoxide and stirred to dissolve it before the benzoate salt was charged
added in eight portions with a total addition time of 3 h, at a controlled kettle temperature of 5 C
added to the kettle residue after the solvent was stripped, and stirred to dissolve it; water is also the rinse for the filtered solid, where no amount is given
added dropwise to the aqueous residue until the system reached pH 3

procedure_text: 向2-四氢呋喃甲醇醇钠中加入200mL  THF，搅拌溶解后控制釜温在5℃，将步骤(1)制备得到的2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸钠盐(98.2％，0.1mol)分八次加入反应瓶中，总加料时间为3h，加毕保温反应3h。反应完毕，负压脱溶，釜残加水120mL，搅拌溶解后滴加浓盐酸将体系pH值酸化至3，之后经过滤、水淋洗、烘干得到产物33.1g，HPLC定量得目标化合物2-氯-3-[(RS)-四氢呋喃-2-基甲氧基甲基]-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸含量为97.5％，以2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯计两步反应收率92.5％。
procedure_summary: The solid sodium alkoxide is dissolved in tetrahydrofuran and the sodium benzoate salt from the first step is added in portions at a controlled low kettle temperature, then held at that temperature, the alkoxide displacing the benzylic bromide to give the ether. The solvent is stripped under reduced pressure, the residue is dissolved in water and acidified with concentrated hydrochloric acid added dropwise, and the product is filtered, rinsed with water and dried, its content being determined by quantitative liquid chromatography.
notes: Heading of the document's step (2), in translation: preparation of 2-chloro-3-[(RS)-tetrahydrofuran-2-ylmethoxymethyl]-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid, with the remark that the main reaction process can be represented by the reaction equation that follows. That heading covers both the alkoxide preparation and this etherification, which is why its line is inside this record's provenance span but not inside its procedure_text. The benzylic bromide of the benzoate salt is displaced by the sodium alkoxide, hence nucleophilic_substitution with Williamson ether synthesis as the named reaction. The concentrated hydrochloric acid is a workup acidification that liberates the free acid, not a reagent of the substitution, so it sits in the workup with the pH target; is_one_pot is false because the solvent is stripped and water added before the acid goes in, which is a workup between the substitution and the acidification. The pH is recorded as the workup target and the reaction pH is left null, no pH being controlled during the reaction itself. Vessel naming is internally inconsistent inside one sentence: the kettle temperature is controlled while the benzoate salt is said to be added to the reaction flask. reactor_type records the kettle, which the alkoxide preparation also used and which the rest of the paragraph operates, and the flask wording is recorded here; no validation flag covers a vessel naming inconsistency. The total addition time and the addition in eight portions belong to the benzoate salt addition profile, while time_h carries the hold after the addition was complete; both happen to be printed as 3 h and they are separate figures. precursor_step names Step 1, whose product identifier is charged here and which the text points to explicitly, so linkage_confirmed is true; the alkoxide reactant comes from Step 2a of this same section, which the single precursor_step field cannot also carry, and it is recorded here instead. Drawing against prose: the scheme drawn for this step gives the benzoate salt a sodium counter ion and describes the alkoxide on the arrow as the sodium alkoxide, and the prose says sodium in both places, so the sodium against potassium disagreement this patent shows in other examples is checked and absent here and no drawing_text_conflict is raised. The scheme also lists HCl, which the prose has; it draws no solvent, and tetrahydrofuran is treated as the medium rather than as a reagent missing from the arrow, so no reagent flag is raised either. The (RS) descriptor is kept because the prose prints it; the drawn product carries no stereo bond. The stated 92.5 percent is a two step yield based on methyl 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate and not a yield for this step alone; it is recorded on the product as printed, and the basis compound is carried on the Step 1 record, where it is the material consumed. The printed product mass, the liquid chromatography content and the two step yield close against the nominal charge of the benzoate salt, so no arithmetic flag is raised; the working is in the provenance sidecar. purification is null: the product is isolated by filtration, water rinsing and drying, with no purification technique stated.
